title: Machine learning in seismology: 30 real papers
selectionNote: Sixty real papers on machine learning in seismology and the datasets that enable it. The original thirty are retained; thirty additions were selected through verified bibliography links to that collection. Shared-theme edges describe curated subject overlap; citation edges come from indexed references. Inclusion illustrates research workflows and does not endorse predictive or operational claims.
rightsNote: Bibliographic attribution and unchanged publisher PDFs retain their article licenses. Optional downloads and the separate offline archive include attribution and reviewed rights evidence. Article PDFs are not bundled in the installer or Pages site.
